name: Ordinary SAM2.1 decoder-core adaptation baseline
scope: Exploratory sequence-grouped PolypGen CV. No regional mechanism, frame selection, confidence gate, later GT prompt or new inference threshold.
settings: Inherit ordinary_baseline unchanged from parent: three folds, 40 epochs, 560 updates/fold, 8-frame clips, AdamW5e-6/weight_decay0.01/clip1, raw-mask author losses, final epoch only.
sampling_seed: parent.seed + fold_number*100000 + epoch_zero_based*14 + training_sequence_index_zero_based; training sequences retain parent.sequences order
prerequisites: Completed official native cohort and its independent audit; passed ordinary training engineering gate and independent receipt audit; complete ordinary propagation gate with identical source inventory.
propagation_gate: On complete seq2/seq13, fresh official weights reproduce native prediction and stored-output hashes. Then diagnostic gate weights propagate autonomously, see four layers each frame, retain native key/pointer schedules, and remain unchanged. Diagnostic weights never initialise CV.
training: Only training-fold native banks may be loaded during optimization. Teacher prefix is strictly past native history, then own differentiable predicted writes within each seven-target block. No full-video on-policy training claim.
evaluation: Original full videos, original prompt only. No cached teacher bank or GT beyond metric scoring. Save every frame, layer schedule, object score and mask occupancy; verify weights before/after evaluation. Native reference uses same official checkpoint and prompt.
reporting: Primary equal-sequence present-frame Dice, paired sequence-bootstrap interval and Wilcoxon; frozen parent meaningful-gain screen. Also IoU, Boundary F, empty-frame false alarms with denominator, censored re-detection events and runtime. A significant training-loss decrease is not an efficacy result.
checkpoint_rule: Save final decoder core before validation, anchor its SHA in a receipt, never choose checkpoints or hyperparameters from held-out results.
stopping: Stop on nonfinite outputs/gradients, source or asset mismatch, wrong layer/token/pointer schedule, frozen-weight mutation, native-replay mismatch or incomplete coverage. Unexpected Dice is recorded without changing the design.
external: Deferred. Existing PolypGen sequences are not untouched external confirmation; patient independence unverified.
implementation: Reuse pinned SAM2 predictor, author sampler/loss and verified project cache/training/metric/statistical helpers. This orchestration is a project adaptation, not unchanged full SAM2 training.
